title: Who Was to Say So
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：question　|　正文 313 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 question 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① question was never whether to sell; that had been decided in March, before anybody told me. The ② question, as my mother put it, was who was to say so out loud, and for eleven weeks nobody did. It was not ③ a question of money — there was never enough of it to be one — but of who would be the one to sign.

My brother said it was ④ beyond question that the farm could not go on, and he said it every day for eleven weeks, which is a way of saying that it was very much ⑤ in question. My sister said selling was ⑥ out of the question and then, in June, sold her own share to him, which nobody has mentioned since.

What I could not get past was the ⑦ question of the house itself: my grandmother's name is cut into the step, and a house with a name cut into the step is not ⑧ a question of price, whatever my brother says. He said I was being sentimental; I said he was being quick; and there is ⑨ no question that we were both right.

In the end the question was decided by the bank, in eleven minutes, by a woman who had never seen the step. My brother signed. My mother, who had not spoken for weeks, said afterwards that this ⑩ called the whole thing into question, and I think she meant the family rather than the farm. Nobody in the room said the word, which we had all been saying for eleven weeks and which by then meant nothing to anybody.

I have not been back. The question of whether we did the right thing is one I have stopped asking, which my brother says is the same as answering it, and which I think is not. He is right about most things and wrong about this one.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 问题；疑问；难题
B. n. 议题；待决定的事
C. 固定搭配：no question (that) 毫无疑问
D. 固定搭配：beyond question 毫无疑问；无可争辩
E. 固定搭配：out of the question 不可能；根本不予考虑
F. 固定搭配：in question 成问题的；正在讨论中的
G. 固定搭配：a question of ... ……的问题（取决于……）
H. 固定搭配：call sth. into question 对……提出质疑

items.q: The question was never whether to sell
The question, as my mother put it, was who was to say so
It was not a question of money
it was beyond question that the farm could not go on
it was very much in question
selling was out of the question
the question of the house itself
is not a question of price
there is no question that we were both right
called the whole thing into question

answers.why: the question 意为“问题、疑问”，说问题从来不是卖不卖。
the question 意为“待决定的事、议题”，母亲说要定的是由谁开口。
a question of ... 意为“……的问题、取决于……”，说这不是钱的问题。
beyond question 意为“毫无疑问”，哥哥说农场维持不下去是毫无疑问的。
in question 意为“成问题的、悬而未决的”，他天天说，恰恰说明这事大有疑问。
out of the question 意为“不可能、根本不予考虑”，姐姐说出售绝不可能。
the question of ... 意为“……的问题”，我过不去的是房子本身这一关。
a question of ... 意为“……的问题”，刻着名字的房子不是价钱的问题。
no question that 意为“毫无疑问”，毫无疑问我们俩都是对的。
call sth. into question 意为“对……提出质疑”，母亲说这件事让整件事都成了疑问。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 问题从来不是要不要卖。（question）
那不是一个钱的问题。（a question of）
我哥哥说农场维持不下去了，这是毫无疑问的。（beyond question）
我姐姐说出售是绝不可能的。（out of the question）
这件事让整件事都成了疑问。（call sth. into question）
毫无疑问，我们俩都是对的。（no question that）
answers: The question was never whether to sell.
It was not a question of money.
My brother said it was beyond question that the farm could not go on.
My sister said selling was out of the question.
My mother said this called the whole thing into question.
There is no question that we were both right.
